users_self_or_teammate_select.name: users_self_or_teammate_select
users_self_or_teammate_select.using:
id = (select auth.uid()) or exists (
    select 1 from public.memberships m
    where m.user_id = users.id
      and public.is_current_user_tenant_member(m.tenant_id)
  )

listings_storefront_anon_select.name: listings_storefront_anon_select
listings_storefront_anon_select.using: tenant_id = (select public.storefront_tenant_id()) and status in ('available', 'reserved', 'sold') and published_at is not null

listings_battery_range.name: listings_battery_range
listings_battery_range.value: battery_pct is null or (battery_pct between 0 and 100)

listing_photos_storefront_anon_select.name: listing_photos_storefront_anon_select
listing_photos_storefront_anon_select.using: tenant_id = (select public.storefront_tenant_id()) and exists (select 1 from listings l where l.id = listing_photos.listing_id)

wa_click_events_storefront_insert.name: wa_click_events_storefront_insert
wa_click_events_storefront_insert.withCheck: tenant_id = (select public.storefront_tenant_id()) and (listing_id is null or exists (select 1 from listings l where l.id = listing_id and l.tenant_id = (select public.storefront_tenant_id())))

sales_tenant_insert.name: sales_tenant_insert
sales_tenant_insert.withCheck: tenant_id = (select auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid and public.is_current_user_tenant_member(tenant_id) and public.is_current_user_tenant_owner(tenant_id) or tenant_id = (select auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid and public.is_current_user_tenant_member(tenant_id) and public.is_current_user_tenant_member(tenant_id) and not public.is_current_user_tenant_owner(tenant_id) and internal_notes is null and sold_by = (select auth.uid())

tradein_leads_storefront_insert.name: tradein_leads_storefront_insert
tradein_leads_storefront_insert.withCheck: tenant_id = (select public.storefront_tenant_id()) and exists (select 1 from tenants t where t.id = tradein_leads.tenant_id and t.accepts_trade_in)
